post.caption:
Goosebumps are tiny muscles at each follicle trying to raise hairs for insulation or intimidation. It works on a furry animal. On us it makes bumps. Same with the tailbone, wisdom teeth, ear-wiggling muscles, and the palmaris longus tendon that about 14% of people are simply born without.
